note: hand-written before any round-4 extractor code ran, by reading the Go (the fixture is read, not run). Each case is a module under this directory.

wiring.Gen: generic helper expose[T] -> RegisterService; descriptor var genx.Descriptor; impl genx.New(opts...) (options constructor returning the interface, concrete *service); Put is the embedded stub
wiring.Twin: the same helper at a second call site; descriptor &w4.Twin_ServiceDesc; impl newTwin() returns the interface (concrete twinDesk)
wiring.Reg: init() offers registry.InstallFunc(install) (a func-type adapter); InstallAll ranges the map of Installer values
wiring.RegB: init() offers adapter{} (a struct implementing Installer)
wiring.Ghost: ghost implements Installer but nothing ever builds one: its Install never runs

main.dead: internal/legacy.Mount (a RegisterService call with an unresolvable descriptor) is referenced from nowhere and imported by nobody: dead, so it must not block not_registered

wiring.Mystery: RegisterService(descs[name], impl) with name read from the environment: the descriptor cannot be resolved
wiring.Orphan: declared, never registered -- but an unresolved registration exists in the module, so nothing may be said with confidence

wiring.Held: registered inside a function literal held in the package variable holder, which only the unreferenced function unreachedMount reads (round-3 deviation 8.7)
wiring.Lone: declared, never registered -- beside an unresolved registration
